label: preparing
what: A coordinated, apparently undisclosed plan concerning a bridge or port change, discussed at the bakery; evidence also indicates the baker arranged delivery of eighty loaves to the hall, possibly for an event related to it. The records do not establish the precise proposal or prove that the hall/loaves are part of the same plan. Freight and the secretary knowingly help with the hall delivery/inspection logistics; the neighbour is implicated in the reported bakery discussion, but their role beyond participation is unclear.
